name: A captive among the cedars
summary: In the cedar country of Grizzly Hills, Drakuru waits behind the bars of a cage at Granite Springs. He is a Drakkari troll, held after the forest’s struggles have brought him into human custody. His warning is plain: he remembers many heads he has taken, yet proposes that old enemies set their quarrel aside for a time. The offered truce is uneasy, but the prisoner says he knows things that could help against the dangers gathering here.
